about: One metric per stage, per funnel. Only + - * /. Every rate is one count divided by another.

vr.name: Visit Rate

dr_e.name: email delivered rate

lr.name: page load rate

ac_l.name: acceptance rate

ms_l.name: message reach

cr_l.name: LinkedIn click rate
